editorial:
Imagine you are a stressed-out boss who just needs a break, so you fly off to Hawaii for some sun and sand. That is exactly where you start with this story. You meet a beautiful businesswoman, and things seem great at first. But there is a catch. A weird family curse is tied to your bloodline, and it starts messing with your new romance in a supernatural way. The vibe is a mix of a vacation romance and a spooky mystery that keeps you wondering if the main character is losing his mind or if ghosts are actually chasing him.

The acting is pretty solid for a TV movie from the seventies, and the mystery keeps you interested even when the plot gets a bit wild. Some parts move a little slow, but the twists make up for it. If you like old-school horror that feels like a weird dream, you will love this. Since it is an older flick, you might want to look for a 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection for the best picture, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie ends when you realize the curse is not just a legend but a real force trying to stop the couple from being together. In the final scenes, the main character has to face his family history to break the spell. He manages to overcome the supernatural pull of the curse, allowing him and the woman to finally find peace. It wraps up by showing that love can beat even the weirdest family ghosts.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old TV movies and supernatural mysteries.
